item: scripts/handoff.js execute LEAD-FINAL-APPROVAL timed out (exit 143) for -G, same as -F immediately before it (2nd consecutive occurrence) — DB write completes cleanly before the process is killed both times; logged as a harness_backlog feedback row (8d9f23b4) for investigation into the slow post-write step

first VALIDATION pass at LEAD wrongly recommended skipping declaredAddresseeRole registration, citing a general widening-caution comment, without cross-checking the chairman-ratified Solomon Q6 adjudication that explicitly required it. Caught and corrected before PLAN-TO-EXEC via a follow-up Explore pass. A code-level scoping comment can be locally correct but still be overridden by a higher-authority ratified decision, and the first pass should have checked the spec and adjudication docs before recommending a scope cut

gauge-registry.js own header comment (STUB-ROW ADOPTION CONTRACT, describing detectorFn null for stub entries) is stale relative to the live enforced test, which requires a non-null string detectorFn for every entry including stubs. The 3 pre-existing self_score_age stub entries already follow the string-key convention, not null. The header comment should be corrected in a future doc-only pass
